card.name: FIG or TABLE label starting a caption
card.fires_on: The word FIG or TABLE in capitals right after a sentence ends, where a figure or table caption begins. Also fires inside capitalized brand names in all-caps (e.g. ENSACOVE, HARVONI, TREK).

modes.label: Caption start
modes.description: FIG or TABLE in capitals just after a full stop, opening a figure or table caption.

modes.label: Inside capitalized drug names
modes.description: Middle letters of an all-caps brand name, often after a heading or opening parenthesis.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a figure or table caption begins, and sometimes the middle of a capitalized drug name.
